# Serialization compatibility golden data

`nca013_serialization_v012.rds` was generated by sourcing the unchanged `PKDesktop-R-0.12.0-alpha-20261109/source/apps/pk-desktop/pkapp.R` in an independent R environment. All expected prepared frames, canonical values, v1/v2 signatures, serialized row/array/baseline strings, and validation diagnostic messages came from that release's functions. The candidate serializer was not used to produce expectations.

Producer `R/pk_preprocessing.R` SHA256: `45f56c68f59014bbd2e9016b98894c71dec4ca98c1815d4551e10bc69bf91a48`.
Fixture SHA256: `ed70257e304814da8f9b6c756a5ad13409d4942106b95182adc1d811fe82fc4a`.
Runtime: R 4.6.1, jsonlite 2.0.0, digest 0.6.39.

The fixture contains 8 preparation cases, 13 validation scenarios, and 15 canonical string/null rows. Cases cover zero/one/multiple profile keys, a singleton profile, half-LLOQ processing, constant LLOQ, escaped column names, and nearby numeric identity values that have equal `as.character()` output but distinct canonical `%.17g` output. String cases include Unicode, escaped quotes and backslashes, control characters, empty/null values, literal delimiter text, and exponent/negative-zero text.

The test runs from the source root using only this fixture and the existing historical `prepared_v1_constant.csv` / `prepared_v1_column.csv`. Do not regenerate expectations with a changed implementation. Historical v1 CSVs remain untouched.
